newsitem.title: USA: Holtz execs denied control of Capital Bancorp unit.
newsitem.headline: Holtz execs denied control of Capital Bancorp unit.

text.p: Florida's state comptroller denied an application by a group of executives seeking to acquire a controlling interest in Capital Bank, a subsidiary of Capital Bancorp, the parent company said on Tuesday.
The application was filed by Fana Holtz, the vice chairman of the board of Capital Bancorp, Daniel Holtz, the chairman of the Capital Bancorp board, and Capital Bancorp president Javier Holtz.
The group applied to acquire a controlling interest in Capital Bank through their ownership in the parent company, Captial Bancorp said in a statement.

However, the comptroller ordered that the applicants "must take such actions within 90 days as are necessary so that members of the family do not own, control or have the power to vote 25 percent or more of any class of voting securities," in either the bank or its parent company, Capital Bancorp said.
